[EN] Where Are They Now?
[ES] ¿Dónde están ahora?
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] What if she doesn't know?
[ES] ¿Y si ella no lo sabe?
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] If not bodies, they must want something even more precious. I have a bad feeling about this.
[ES] Si no son cuerpos, deben querer algo aún más preciado. Tengo crueles sospechas sobre esto.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll ask her."
[ES] "Se lo preguntaré".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Tanseril about the argons.
[ES] Pregúntale a Tanseril sobre los argons.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Still, it's good to know."
[ES] "Aun así, es bueno saberlo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Nila at the Grand Gate Watchpost south of Scythera Fae. Find out what she's seen of the argons.
[ES] Encuentra a Nila en el puesto de vigilancia Grand Gate, al sur de Scythera Fae. Averigua qué ha visto de los argons.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
